# Ornith 1.5 122B

Ornith 1.5 122B is a mixture-of-experts reasoning model with about 10B active parameters. It takes text and image input. RunInfra serves it as ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-122B at $0.20 per 1M input tokens and $0.80 per 1M output tokens. Its context window is 262,144 tokens. The API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions and Anthropic-compatible Messages, POST /v1/messages.
